author: curriculum-architect
songSummary: Practices steady beat, finding the note E, echoing short up and down patterns, counting to three and taking turns, with a sleepy shepherd boy.

classes.title: Where is the boy?
classes.goal: Hear the whole song and notice its question and its answer.

mathTarget.parentLine: One line asks a question, the next line answers it

classes.parentPrompt: Sway together; on 'where is the boy?' shrug, and on 'fast asleep' rest your heads.
classes.childAction: Sway, shrug on the question, pretend to sleep on the answer.
classes.bridge: The song asks a question, then answers it with a sleepy lie-down.

intro.caption: Sway in the meadow
intro.parentCue: sit together and sway side to side

intro.caption: Where is the boy? Shh, asleep!
intro.parentCue: Shrug together, then rest your heads

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: hearing a question and an answer in a song.

classes.title: Sheep and cow footsteps
classes.goal: Tap one steady tap on every beat while the grown-up plays the tune.

mathTarget.parentLine: One tap for each beat, no more, no less

classes.parentPrompt: Pat your knees slowly together first, then move to the keys.
classes.childAction: Tap any key once for every footstep in the meadow.
classes.bridge: Each beat is one hoof step in the meadow: clip, clop, clip, clop.

intro.caption: Tap with the circle
intro.parentCue: Pat your knees together before the keys

games.caption: Meadow steps, nice and even
games.parentCue: Tap with your child, one tap per beat

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: one tap for each beat.

classes.title: Find the boy's note E
classes.goal: Find E on the piano by touch, next to the two black keys.

mathTarget.parentLine: Using the two black keys as a signpost to find E

classes.parentPrompt: Touch the two black keys together, then slide right to the white key E.
classes.childAction: Find two black keys, slide right, press E like a button.
classes.bridge: Two black keys are the haystack; E sits just to the right of it.

intro.caption: Where does E live?
intro.parentCue: Touch the two black keys together first

games.caption: E, E, E: one, two, three
games.parentCue: Count out loud with each press

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: finding E next to the two black keys.

classes.title: Blow your horn: up!
classes.goal: Listen to a short call of 2 or 3 notes, then copy it back.

mathTarget.parentLine: Holding two or three sounds in mind, then playing them back

classes.parentPrompt: Play the call, then hold your hands in your lap while your child answers.
classes.childAction: Listen to the horn call, then play it back the same.
classes.bridge: The horn climbs up the stairs to the right: E, F, G, toot!

intro.caption: Listen, then echo me
intro.parentCue: Pretend to blow a horn together first

games.caption: Horn goes up: E, F, G
games.parentCue: Lift your hands like a horn as it climbs

games.caption: Boy Blue goes down: E, D, C
games.parentCue: Lower your hands as it walks down

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: listening and copying short tunes.

classes.title: Where is he? Again!
classes.goal: Echo a short pattern and notice when the song plays it twice.

mathTarget.parentLine: Spotting the same little tune played two times in a row

classes.parentPrompt: After the first C, D, E, say 'again!' and play it once more.
classes.childAction: Echo C, D, E, then shout 'again!' and play it twice.
classes.bridge: C, D, E is three little steps up; the song walks them twice.

games.caption: C, D, E, and again!
games.parentCue: Point to each lit key, nice and slow

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: spotting a pattern that repeats.

classes.title: Wait for E, then toot!
classes.goal: Wait and play E at the right moments while the grown-up plays the rest.

mathTarget.parentLine: Waiting for your turn, then playing exactly then

classes.parentPrompt: Play the blue keys; nod to your child just before each coral E.
classes.childAction: Hands in your lap, then play E when it lights up.
classes.bridge: E is the horn: you blow it only when the song calls you.

intro.caption: Listen for E
intro.parentCue: Hands in laps until the coral E lights

games.caption: Two Es: one, two
games.parentCue: Hold up two fingers and count together

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: waiting for your turn, then playing E.

classes.title: Sleepy D, wake-up E
classes.goal: Listen and play the right one of two notes, D or E, in the song.

mathTarget.parentLine: Hearing which of two sounds it is, then choosing its key

classes.parentPrompt: Touch D and say 'sleepy', touch E and say 'wake up', then play.
classes.childAction: Play D or E, whichever key lights up.
classes.bridge: D is between the two black keys, cosy; E is just outside, awake.

intro.caption: Listen for E and D
intro.parentCue: Touch D, then E, saying their names

games.caption: Snoring boy: E, D, E, D
games.parentCue: Make a soft snore with each note

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: telling D and E apart.

classes.title: Shepherd and helper
classes.goal: Play the whole song together, each with your own notes, on a shared beat.

mathTarget.parentLine: Two players keeping the same steady beat

classes.parentPrompt: Nod the beat before you start; keep playing even if a note is missed.
classes.childAction: Play your notes and nod along with your grown-up.
classes.bridge: Two shepherds, one meadow: walk the song together, step by step.

intro.caption: Play it together
intro.parentCue: Nod the beat together before you start

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing together on one shared beat.

classes.title: Wake teddy up concert
classes.goal: Play the whole song for teddy, from the first note to the last, then bow.

mathTarget.parentLine: A song has a start, a middle and an end

classes.parentPrompt: Lay teddy down 'asleep'; play the song, then let teddy wake and clap.
classes.childAction: Play for sleepy teddy, hold the last note, then bow.
classes.bridge: The last note goes home to C, like the boy curled up asleep.

intro.caption: A song for teddy
intro.parentCue: Lay teddy down, pretending to sleep

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing a whole song, start to end.
